title: Compact set-valued deep ensembling in multi-class classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.05332v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper tackles visible challenges in deep ensemble learning, where deep neural networks serve as ensemble members: training and storage burdens, and robustness of cautious (set-valued) predictions targeting multiple utilities, which may involve reward-sensitivity. To mitigate the training and storage burdens, we propose to employ compact ensembles, such as Bayesian Neural Networks and Convolutional Neural Networks with the Monte-Carlo dropout prediction option, to produce probabilistic predictions. For each query instance, these probabilistic predictions are then used to define a representative distribution optimizing some statistical distance. The representative distribution is then employed to define the Bayes-optimal prediction (BOP) of any utility. translated_title: 多类分类中的紧凑集合值深度集成学习
translated_abstract: 本文解决深度集成学习（其中深度神经网络作为集成成员）中面临的显著挑战：训练与存储负担，以及针对多种效用（可能涉及奖励敏感性）的谨慎（集合值）预测的鲁棒性。为减轻训练和存储负担，我们提出采用紧凑集成方法，例如贝叶斯神经网络和具有蒙特卡洛dropout预测选项的卷积神经网络，来生成概率预测。对于每个查询实例，这些概率预测随后被用于定义一个优化某种统计距离的代表性分布，进而利用该代表性分布来定义任意效用下的贝叶斯最优预测（BOP）。为解决单点预测可能存在的非鲁棒性问题，我们提出了一族满足若干理想性质的集合效用，其集合值BOP可以被求解。
tldr: 该论文提出利用紧凑集成（贝叶斯神经网络和蒙特卡洛dropout卷积神经网络）生成概率预测并构建代表性分布以定义贝叶斯最优预测，同时引入一族集合效用来实现减轻训练与存储负担且更鲁棒的集合值多类分类预测。
en_tdlr: This paper employs compact ensembles (Bayesian Neural Networks and CNNs with Monte-Carlo dropout) to produce probabilistic predictions and define Bayes-optimal predictions via a representative distribution, while introducing a family of set-utilities to achieve robust set-valued predictions with reduced training and storage burdens in multi-class classification.
